pages.text: Goes on the $(thing)right$() of a Coffee Machine, as you face its front. It adds a $(thing)milk slot$() in the top right.

Milk is optional. If a $(item)Milk Bucket$() is in the slot when a cup finishes, the cup is made $(thing)with milk$(), which adds 30 seconds of $(thing)Regeneration$().$(br2)The empty bucket stays in the slot. A hopper on the frother feeds it.
